# MSFT: close on 2026-08-07 to close on 2026-09-06

The starting close is about $499 (two secondary sources, $499.05 and $499.99). The stock had just risen about 25% in a few sessions after earnings. I couldn't open Yahoo Finance or any other page directly because the proxy refused every fetch, so all figures below come from search-result summaries. Several results were dated after 2026-08-09, and I left them out.

## 1. Resolution source
- Yahoo Finance MSFT daily history decides the outcome. I couldn't load it because the proxy refused the connection.
- 2026-08-07: StatMuse lists open $498.27, high $504.23, low $497.79, close $499.05, volume about 28.8M. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/microsoft-stock-price-august-chart)
- 2026-08-07: another analysis gives the close as $499.99, about 28% above the July 29 pre-earnings level. The two figures differ by about $1, so confirm on Yahoo. [money365](https://www.money365.market/articles/microsoft-q2-2026-earnings-analysis)
- 2026-08-06: StatMuse lists the close at about $498.92. A Polymarket page summary gave $499.86. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/msft-close-above-on-august-7-2026)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet; about 4 weeks of trading remain. At the starting price, each $5 move in the stock is about 1% on the question.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-08-07: heavy trading in the $505 calls expiring August 7, about 75.8K contracts. [Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/notable-friday-option-activity-msft-mchp-avgo)
- 2026-08-04: 24/7 Wall St described a "25% three-day rally". [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/04/microsoft-price-prediction-after-a-25-three-day-rally-heres-where-the-stock-is-headed/)
- 2026-08-03: shares rose about 4.7% to 5.5%, to near $487. Citing MarketWatch, one report called the run (about 23% over three sessions) the best three-day gain since October 2000. Strategists warned the stock was overbought. [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/news/market-movers/262070900-market-movers-msft-20260803), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/microsoft-stock-jumps-4-9-203413924.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/02/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)
- 2026-07-30 to early August: analysts raised price targets.
  - Cantor Fitzgerald: $608, from $522.
  - Citi: $600, from $570.
  - Benchmark: $525.
  - DA Davidson and JPMorgan: kept $550.
  - Redburn: $440, with a Neutral rating, citing $330B in lease commitments that haven't started yet.
  - Sources: [247wallst](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/07/30/microsoft-surges-9-as-azure-tops-100b-and-q4-beat-lifts-most-price-targets/?.tsrc=rss), [TradersUnion](https://tradersunion.com/news/financial-news/show/3420085-microsoft-ai-azure-growth-split/), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/microsoft-corp-msft-price-target-143459021.html)
- 2026-07-30: Fortune covered the roughly $480B gain in market value. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/07/30/why-did-microsoft-stock-increase-500-billion-market-cap/)
- 2026-07-29: fiscal Q4 2026 results.
  - Revenue was $90.0B (up 18%) against a $87.6B consensus.
  - Non-GAAP EPS was $4.74 against $4.24 expected.
  - Azure grew 43%, up from 40% the prior quarter, with Q1 FY27 guidance of about 44.5%.
  - Copilot passed 30M paid seats.
  - Shares rose about 8% after hours, to about $422.
  - Sources: [SEC 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000789019/000119312526323632/msft-ex99_1.htm), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-msft-q4-earnings-report-2026.html), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/microsoft-q4-2026-earnings-azure-111058880.html)

## 4. Base rates
- I couldn't retrieve a clean price series to compute these myself.
- Historically MSFT has a 1-month standard deviation of about 6% to 7%, which assumes annualized volatility of about 22% to 25%. That gives a roughly 68% range of about -7% to +7% over 4 weeks.
- Realized volatility right now is far above normal because of the roughly 25% post-earnings jump. That points to a wider range, perhaps ±8% to 10% for one standard deviation. I couldn't find a pre-August 9 implied volatility reading.
- Pattern to keep in mind: after very large gaps up on earnings, large caps often either consolidate or drift further in the same direction. A sample of one is not evidence either way.
- Context: by early June, before this rally, MSFT was down for 2026. The rally brought it back to around $500. [TIKR](https://www.tikr.com/blog/microsoft-stock-is-down-5-this-year-but-its-up-33-since-june-heres-where-shares-could-go-in-2026)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket has short-dated MSFT markets (daily and weekly close). I couldn't fetch their prices, and I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market covering the September 4 close. [Polymarket weekly](https://polymarket.com/event/msft-week-august-7-2026)
- Analyst 12-month targets: most sit at $515 to $637 (Bernstein $637, Cantor $608, Citi $600), and Redburn is the outlier at $440. These are 12-month targets, not 1-month forecasts. [TipRanks/TheFly](https://www.tipranks.com/news/the-fly/microsoft-price-target-raised-to-637-from-540-at-bernstein-thefly)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (dates are typical timing, not confirmed)
- Mid-August: July CPI and PPI releases, plus 13F filings showing institutional positioning.
- Around August 20 to 22: Fed Jackson Hole symposium.
- Late August: Nvidia earnings, a major signal for AI and cloud sentiment.
- Late August: July PCE inflation.
- 2026-09-04: August jobs report, released the same day as the final close that counts.
- Ongoing: news on the OpenAI relationship, AI capital spending and capacity announcements, and possible profit-taking after an overbought run.
